name: 79-ugjuknarpak
description: Ugjuknarpak: a giant grey bearded seal reared up on its hind flippers like a bear, two long ivory tusks, a pale whiskery beard, clawed fore-flippers raised. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Reared up in place, clawing the air: it raises its left clawed flipper high and rakes down, opens its tusked mouth wide in a roar, then raises its right clawed flipper and rakes down. Hind flippers planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
idle.views_note: views reassigned by eye (views.py): PixelLab's rotate names ran a step round
